source.name: anaBokra career decision readiness check (pre/post outcome metric)
source.license: anaBokra — draft for the psychologist to validate
source.notes: Asked at onboarding (B5) and after the reveal (E2). The change from pre to post is anaBokra's main outcome metric.

text.en: I know which careers might suit me
I know what I need to study to reach the careers I like
text.ar: أعرف لازم أدرس إيه علشان أوصل للمهن اللي بحبها

text.en: I feel confident about choosing my major
I know where to find reliable information about universities and programs
text.ar: أعرف ألاقي معلومات موثوقة عن الجامعات والبرامج منين

text.en: Thinking about my future career makes me anxious
I have a plan for my next steps
